results.rationale: Consistency: turquoise sandal, polish, ankle and rainy setting remain; wet pavement reflections and texture are noticeably redrawn. Instruction: toes are smoothed and reshaped but all seven remain, so the excess digits are not corrected. Quality: seven elongated toes create a major anatomical failure despite otherwise coherent skin and sandal materials.

Consistency: painting identity and burgundy frame remain, but internal bird/branch details and carved frame ornament are redrawn. Instruction: centered painting, blue gradient, clouds, flying cranes and glow are present; title uses script instead of serif and bottom-left event text is largely nonsensical. Quality: main composition is coherent, but multiple garbled event lines and visible watermark-like text create distracting textual artifacts.
